headline: Banking Profitability Slows Early in Second Half of 2026, Banks Become More Cautious
summary: Profits of a number of large national banks in Indonesia have begun to show a slowdown entering the second half of 2026. Banks are becoming more cautious, according to the report.
why: Large Indonesian banks are central to the country's credit system, so their profit trends indicate lending conditions and the health of the broader economy.
